## Overview


support the [`--enable-force-include-usage`](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/stable/cli/serve/#-enable-force-include-usage-no-enable-force-include-usage) frontend flag in rust

## Claims


`--enable-force-include-usage` now works for rust frontend, same as python frontend

## Validation


server start command 
```bash
> VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 VLLM_RUST_FRONTEND_PATH=$PWD/rust/target/release/vllm-rs vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B --dtype float16 --max-model-len 4096 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.25 --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-force-include-usage
```

test command + output
```bash
> curl -s localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the weather in Paris?"}],"tools":[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"get_weather","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}},"required":["city"]}}}],"tool_choice":"auto", "stream":true}'

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-114d13e1","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1791309997,"model":"Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":271,"total_tokens":297,"completion_tokens":26,"prompt_tokens_details":null,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0}}}

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-114d13e1","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1791309997,"model":"Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B","choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":271,"total_tokens":297,"completion_tokens":26,"prompt_tokens_details":null,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0}}}

data: [DONE]
```

## Details


wiring up `--enable-force-include-usage` and `--no-enable-force-include-usage`, removing from unsupported list

files.patch:
@@ -340,6 +340,26 @@ pub struct SharedRuntimeArgs {
     #[serde(default)]
     pub enable_prompt_tokens_details: bool,
 
+    /// If set to True, including usage on every request.
+    #[arg(
+        long,
+        default_missing_value = "true",
+        num_args = 0..=1,
+        overrides_with = "no_enable_force_include_usage"
+    )]
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub enable_force_include_usage: bool,
+
+    /// Negation of `--enable-force-include-usage`, matching Python's
+    /// `--no-enable-force-include-usage`
+    #[arg(
+        long = "no-enable-force-include-usage",
+        default_missing_value = "false",
+        num_args = 0..=1
+    )]
+    #[serde(skip)]
+    no_enable_force_include_usage: bool,
+
     /// If specified, API server will add X-Request-Id header to responses.
     #[arg(
         long,
@@ -625,6 +645,7 @@ impl SharedRuntimeArgs {
         ApiServerOptions {
             enable_log_requests: self.enable_log_requests,
             enable_prompt_tokens_details: self.enable_prompt_tokens_details,
+            enable_force_include_usage: self.enable_force_include_usage,
             enable_request_id_headers: self.enable_request_id_headers,
             enable_scale_out: self.enable_scale_out,
             sse_keep_alive_interval: (self.sse_keep_alive_interval > 0)
